summary: BHP Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K on 14 September 2026 carrying an ASX Appendix 3Y Change of Director's Interest Notice for director Mark Vassella. The notice discloses an on-market purchase of 2,675 ordinary shares on 11 September 2026 at A$60.5000 per share direct and A$60.5099 indirect, lifting holdings to 3,750 direct and 3,750 indirect through the Vassella family trust. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal mechanics are stated; trading did not occur in a closed period. This is a routine insider-interest disclosure, not a special situation.
